verdict.rationale: TruffleHog is an official CLI that runs non-interactively from the command line or a Docker container. It has automation-oriented flags such as `--fail`, `--results=verified,unknown` and `--since-commit`, takes config-file-driven scans, and supports pre-commit and pre-receive hooks for unattended gating. Missing for 10: explicit CI-pipeline integration docs (e.g., GitHub Actions/GitLab CI examples), documented exit-code and machine-readable output semantics, and independent hands-on corroboration of CI use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: If you run your own git server, consider the pre-receive hook option which can block commits with secrets from being accepted.
